features.title: Deploy Frida and bypass Java-layer SSL certificate pinning
features.notes: Deployed frida-server 17.9.1-android-x86_64 to emulator. Applied universal Java-layer SSL unpinning script (scripts/frida_ssl_unpin.js) targeting TrustManager, Conscrypt TrustManagerImpl, SSLContext, HostnameVerifier, and WebView SSL. Successfully intercepted HTTPS traffic: graph.facebook.com (Facebook SDK), qcplay.aihelp.net (AI Help), x2eayo.launches.appsflyersdk.com (AppsFlyer), and cloudfront.net CDN. Conscrypt TrustManagerImpl checkTrustedRecursive() bypass confirmed working. No game-specific API endpoints observed during startup-only capture. Raw flows in captures/private/phase3/20260427T195500/. Sanitized report reports/phase3-frida-unpin-20260427T220000Z.md committed.

features.title: Interactive game session capture with user menu navigation

features.title: Native BoringSSL hooking and application-layer intercept for JPush
features.notes: Analyzed libcocos2dlua.so BoringSSL symbols (SSL_CTX_set_verify, SSL_set_verify, SSL_do_handshake, SSL_read, SSL_write all exported). Frida 17.9.1 cannot enumerate the library as a module; workaround uses /proc/self/maps parsing. Native hooks applied successfully. JPush traffic not visible in short test session (timing-related). Application-layer fallback via SSL_read/SSL_write and VerifyAgent hooks prepared. Report: reports/phase3-native-boringssl-hooking-20260427T230000Z.md.

Native SSL hooks applied but 0 hits (connections pre-established). Persistent TCP/3000 and TCP/50504 connections identified as likely custom protocol. Report: reports/phase3-extended-jpush-capture-20260428T053039Z.md. Raw captures in captures/private/phase3/20260428T053039/ (gitignored).

Runners: scripts/run_phase3_hook.py (attach) and scripts/run_phase3_hook_spawn.py (spawn-gate, ANR issues on emulator).
